ai-product-discovery.label: Product Discovery

title: Know What to Build —
Before You Build It
hero.text: With Frank, you can run deep customer conversations at scale to understand real needs, expectations, and reactions — before you commit time, budget, or roadmap.

title: Say Goodbye to Product
Discovery Confusion
quotes: “Surely everybody wants this product we’ve been building for 6 months…”
“We only talk to a few users — it’s hard to know what’s actually true.”
“Surveys tell us what, but not why.”
“By the time we get feedback, we’ve already built too much.”
“We got some positive response on the beta 6 months ago, but it’s been a while since we had users give feedback.”

solution: Frank lets you test ideas directly with customers, uncovering real needs, reactions, and expectations before you commit.
Run 100s of in-depth conversations to validate patterns and separate signal from noise.
Frank runs real conversations with follow-ups, revealing motivations, objections, and emotional drivers.
Get input early — during ideation and concept stages — so you can course-correct before investing heavily.
Run interviews continuously, adjusting your research goals as you develop your product to get even more concrete insights on what you’re building.

steps.title: 1. Frame the Idea or Concept
steps.text: Share what you want to explore — a product idea, concept, positioning, or problem space. Frank helps structure the right discovery questions.

steps.title: 2. Run Conversations at Scale
steps.text: Customers engage in natural, in-depth interviews — sharing how they think, what they need, and how your idea fits (or doesn’t).

steps.title: 3. Extract Patterns & Direction
steps.text: Frank surfaces themes, objections, desires, and opportunities — helping you understand what to build, refine, or rethink.

learn.title: What You’ll Learn
learn.intro: More AI customer interviews should not mean more work. Frank is like a helpful teammate that knows the answer… just ask him via chat, and he’ll resolve all of your customer doubts in seconds!

items.title: What problems customers are truly trying to solve
items.text: Understand the underlying needs driving behavior — not just surface-level feedback.

items.title: How your product fits into their world
items.text: See how customers would use it, where it adds value, and where it falls short.

cta.title: Don’t build first and validate later.

faq.q: When should I use this — before or after building something?
a: Ideally before. Product Discovery is most valuable in early stages, when ideas are still flexible and cheap to change.

faq.q: How is this different from concept testing surveys?
a: Surveys give limited, predefined answers. Frank uncovers deeper insights through conversation — including unexpected needs and objections.

faq.q: Do I need a fully defined product to start?
a: No. You can explore rough ideas, problem spaces, or early concepts — Frank adapts the conversation accordingly.

faq.q: How many customers should I talk to?
a: With Frank, you’re not limited — you can run 100s of interviews to validate patterns with confidence.

faq.q: Can I iterate on the idea based on feedback?
a: Yes. You can continuously refine and re-test ideas as insights come in.

faq.q: What happens to the insights over time?
a: They’re stored in your dashboard, helping to build a deeper understanding of your market and informing future decisions.

win-loss-analysis.label: Win/Loss Analysis

title: Understand Why Your Leads Converted or Walked Away
hero.text: Your CRM tells you who converted. But do you know why? With Frank, every customer is interviewed automatically after they buy or decide not to - so you can learn what influenced their decision: pricing, competitors, objections, expectations, and everything in between.

title: Know Why Deals Are
Lost or Won
quotes: “We lost the deal. ‘Price’ is basically all we know.”
“Our CRM tells us who we lost. Not why they chose someone else.”
“We keep dropping the price, but people still say it’s too expensive…”
“We signed 10 customers last quarter. Why? Not sure… ”
“I can’t manually investigate every win and loss.”

solution: Automatically see the primary objections, expectations, alternatives, and decision factors behind each loss.
Interview prospects immediately after the decision, while their reasoning is still fresh, and turn the answers into actionable patterns.
Frank probes vague answers to uncover what buyers really mean by price, value, fit, timing, or budget.
Interview new customers after they convert to uncover the motivations and buying triggers behind your wins.
Frank interviews customers automatically and finds recurring patterns across deals, segments, competitors, and reps.

cta.title: Every Sales Conversation Teaches You Something
cta.sub: Turn every deal into an opportunity to learn. And every insight into a better sales funnel.

faq.q: When should Frank interview a lead after a deal is won or lost?
a: As soon as possible, while the decision is still fresh. You can trigger Frank at the point that makes the most sense for your sales process: after a purchase, after a lost opportunity, after a proposal, or when a lead goes cold.

faq.q: Can Frank interview leads who didn’t buy?
a: Yes. That’s one of the most valuable applications of win/loss analysis. Frank can speak with prospects after they decide not to move forward and explore what influenced their decision, including objections, alternatives, pricing, expectations, and competitive factors.

faq.q: Will customers be honest with an AI interviewer?
a: Frank gives people a more neutral environment to share feedback. There’s no salesperson trying to defend the product or respond to criticism, and customers can speak directly with an AI interviewer rather than feeling like they’re being evaluated by the company.

faq.q: Can Frank find out why a customer chose a competitor?
a: Yes. You can specifically investigate alternatives, competitive perceptions, switching considerations, and what ultimately influenced the decision. Frank can then identify recurring competitive opportunities across your conversations.

faq.q: Can Frank tell me more than just “price” or “features”?
a: That’s exactly the point. When someone gives a broad answer like “the price was too high,” Frank can ask follow-up questions to understand what they were comparing it against, what they expected to get for the price, and what ultimately made the difference.

faq.q: Can I see trends across all my won and lost deals?
a: Yes. Frank automatically analyzes conversations across your interviews, allowing you to identify recurring themes, compare segments and cohorts, and track how reasons for winning and losing change over time.

faq.q: Does Frank tell me what I should do next?
a: Frank can identify action items and recommendations from your interviews, with each recommendation linked back to the customer conversations that support it. That gives your team a clear path from customer feedback to action.
